notes: This mapping is CONFIGURABLE DEMO DATA. It reflects commonly understood civic responsibilities but has NOT been verified as an official government routing table.

Authorities vary by jurisdiction: Kamrup Metropolitan reports route to Guwahati Municipal Corporation; Darrang (Mangaldai/Sipajhar/Dalgaon) reports route to Mangaldai Municipal Board and district PHED. The MLA and MP are informational representatives only; they are never set as the resolving authority here.
Routing is deterministic: issue_type + jurisdiction (district) -> authority/department. No AI determines authorities.

pothole.routing_reason: Road surface damage such as potholes is handled by the municipal roads/infrastructure wing.

damaged_road.routing_reason: Deteriorated road surfaces fall under municipal road maintenance.

garbage_overflow.routing_reason: Overflowing collection points are cleared by the municipal solid waste management wing.

illegal_dumping.routing_reason: Waste dumped in unauthorized areas is handled by municipal sanitation enforcement.

broken_streetlight.routing_reason: Streetlight repair is managed by the municipal electrical/street lighting wing.

water_leakage.routing_reason: Leaking water supply infrastructure falls under the city water utility.

blocked_drain.routing_reason: Obstructed drains are cleared by the municipal drainage division.

open_drain.routing_reason: Open/uncovered drainage channels fall under the municipal drainage division.
